title: A rearrangement inequality for a weighted square sum
statement:
Let $a, b, \rho$ be real numbers with $0 \le \rho \le 1$. Then
\[
  a^2 + \rho^2 b^2 \;\le\; \left(\frac{|a+b| + |a-b|}{2}\right)^{\!2} + \rho^2 \left(\frac{|a+b| - |a-b|}{2}\right)^{\!2}.
\]
replaced:
For real $a, b$ and $0 \le \rho \le 1$, writing $u = a+b$ and $v = a-b$,
\[
  a^2 + \rho^2 b^2 \le \Big(\tfrac{|u| + |v|}{2}\Big)^2 + \rho^2 \Big(\tfrac{|u| - |v|}{2}\Big)^2 .
\]
